## How it was checked

<!-- What you tried, on which system. For a change you can see, a screenshot. -->

- [ ] `make verify` passes
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), agreeing to the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org)
- [ ] A streamer-facing change has its screen, tests, Help text and a line in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No secrets, sign-ins, real stream data or anyone's exports in the change
